notes.title: Demo Disc Super Update! (July 2025)
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/42b0bf659f6611abbb4af7aa87adede072925d48.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone! This is HedProtag speaking![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/7533df7aa9a8fbf47da382ab81ee51ed96548b47.jpg"][/img]  
We are happy to announce the latest massive overhaul to the Demo Disc Level.
The focus of this update was first and foremost to implement the [b][i]latest UI and UX Overhaul[/i][/b], trough the inclusion of the new revamped Inventory System with 3D Model previews. Enhanced Examine functions, and completely revamped Sound and Art design.... Bug Fixing, and New Demo Level Additions/Improvements are also found in this update. [b][i]Massive ones like a 60% reduction to overall file size. Now the demo is a tasty 800mb![/i][/b]

The Introduction of the FILES Menu is also added in this menu. Now documents and puzzle hints can be logged and saved... Neat! 
You will experience a much more fleshed out version of this system in the Full Game's Story mode![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/722640a87e58519128723de58f3d5ba09ab7c546.png"][/img][/p][p]Player and UX Experience overhauls come all throughout the update. Primarily trough the inclusion of a [b][i]Brand New Settings Menu[/i][/b] found in both the Start & The In-game Menu. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946061/7922d466bfd2eaf5d1997ca08aa0685186ca7d9a.png"][/img][/p][p]Here are some of the more notable raw and unfiltered patch notes!

[b][i]New Additions/ Improvements[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]Game Build size reduced by 60%+[/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements across the board.[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory Screen Upgrades UI/UX[/p][/*][*][p]Settings Screen Added to Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Graphic Styles Toggles Added[/p][/*][*][p]Proper Vsync Support Added[/p][/*][*][p]Retro Aspect Ratio Support Added 4:3, 16:10[/p][/*][*][p]New resolutions added![/p][/*][*][p]Performance Enhancements across the board[/p][/*][*][p]Potato Mode Added?[/p][/*][*][p]3D Character Model on Inventory Screen[/p][/*][*][p]3D Item Previews[/p][/*][*][p]Documents System  Re-Integrated[/p][/*][*][p]Map System Re-Integrated[/p][/*][*][p]Map System Keeps track of Key Items[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic Status Condition Lights on Inventory Screen[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped Control schemes L2+R2 Aiming, Shooting[/p][/*][*][p]Analog Stick Press for Sprint (toggle)[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped PlayerMovement[/p][/*][*][p]AlternatePlayerMovement Refactorized and Upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Camera Transition smoothing added for Alternate Controls[/p][/*][*][p]Input Unlock angle cooldown and boost parameters.[/p][/*][*][p]Tank Control Rotation Speed tweaked[/p][/*][*][p]Examine UI Upgrades, Zoom in feature, Polished Interface[/p][/*][*][p]Examine UI Interactable Events added [b][i](Check Hipoint-C9)[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Variety updated 2D Sprite work across the board[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped Fixed Cameras[/p][/*][*][p]Dolly camera view toggle added for certain cameras. [b][i]Press Q (R3)[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Camera Look around system implemented. [b][i]Mouse/(Right Analog)[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Demo Disc Level Various updated Camera work across the work[/p][/*][*][p]Added Lacey’s Signature weapon to her inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Added Rusty Pipe to Demo Disc Level[/p][/*][*][p]Added ??? to Demo Disc Level[/p][/*][*][p]Added New Tutorial Segments to Demo Disc Level[/p][/*][*][p]Added New FILES to Demo Disc Level.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Demo Character Select menus[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][i]Various Misc Bug fixes[/i][/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Angel Tape examine model[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Variety persistent savedata notes.title: Hotfix 2.0
notes.content: [h2]Hotfix 2.0! Includes:[/h2][list][*][p]First person camera now functions as intended, a close-up FPS view only available when idle and not holding a weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Medallion podium state saves correctly after loading[/p][/*][*][p]Shooting range timer applies when combining ammo with gun on inventory[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Variety bugs squashed[/p][/*][*][p]Refactorized dolly cameras across the board, less nauseating camera dynamics[/p][/*][*][p]Total Graphical overhaul/environment textures and material assigns across the board updated[/p][/*][*][p]Character texturing and vertex colouring updated[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed variety camera trigger dead spots[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed End level area dead spots[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing player collision in key areas[/p][/*][*][p]Updated more missing game assets[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked visibility of certain puzzle objectives[/p][/*][*][p]Variety player experience improvements[/p][/*][*][p]UI/Menu updates[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content: [p]Fixed initialisation issue with animations after loading a game, but also while saving. Until I fully address how animations are initialised, your weapon will be unequipped when you save a game, this is fine: You can just re-equip it after ^^[/p][p]3 major bugs were caused by this and are now fixed:[/p][p]Getting stuck in the saving menu[/p][p]Animations not working properly after loading a save[/p][p]Bookshelf puzzle not being interactable after loading such a save[/p][p]I will continue working on your feedback, for now this will allow you to fully play the demo with no major issues heheh[/p][p]Have fun![/p]
